templates.description: Landing page that opens with text over a photo banner, then a sign-on or icon card row, choice columns and accordions

templates.description: Heading-led page built around a multi-section form with repeated form groups and a closing accordion

templates.description: Page that opens with a repeated card row and photo hero, then tabbed features, accordions and legal disclosures

templates.description: Short heading-led page with a photo hero, a notice box and a few section headings over default content

templates.name: sitemap-directory
templates.description: Heading-led directory page of grouped text link lists under the global header

templates.name: calculator-landing
templates.description: Heading-led page with section sub-navigation, an embedded calculator, notice box, CTA banner, contact columns and teaser cards

templates.name: shell-page
templates.description: Page with only the global utility bar and primary nav and no main content blocks

templates.description: Heading-led page built around a search/finder tool with results area and a closing accordion
